notes.title: OS update & News
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830550/ded4dff6ce3570b5024d6253b1b952813ae9ed60.png[/img]
[b][h1]Hi everyone,[/h1][/b]

[h2]Thanks for your good reviews of the game. They're very important to us!
We decided not only to fix some bugs but also to update the game itself.[/h2]

[h3]In this update we added:

[b]- Mac and Linux support[/b]
We want Horny Girls to be available for as many people as possible! So now you will be able to play it on any OS.

[b]- UI update[/b]
Since we added support for Mac and Linux, it would be cool to update something for everyone else! So we decided to refresh UI for the game![/h3]

[h2]We hope that our update will improve your experience of the game and bring you as much joy as possible.
[/h2]

[h2]And we also have news! We started our third project: [b]Horny warp![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1539160/Horny_Warp

[h2]If you are interested in it you can also support us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/IlluminatiGames]Patreon[/url]! We will post arts, animations, and test builds there![/h2]

notes.title: Difficulty update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830550/ba5dbc5e55a211448dfb02a6fbf1f45816a97f04.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hi everyone![/b]

[b]Many people[/b] dropped the game because they can't beat the arrows part of the game
And this is bad because they can't see such [b]beautiful art[/b] :D

So here is what you wanted
[b]Difficulty update![/b]

Now it will be easier to beat the game and if you will break all your hearts you can replay only the part where you lost[/h2]
